mn95:22.3: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for arriving at the truth.”
mn95:23.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for striving.”
mn95:23.4: If you don’t weigh up the teachings, you won’t strive.
mn95:23.5: You strive because you weigh up the teachings.
mn95:23.6: That’s why weighing up the teachings is helpful for striving.”
mn95:24.1: “But what quality is helpful for weighing up the teachings?
mn95:24.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for weighing up the teachings.”
mn95:24.4: If you don’t make an attempt, you won’t weigh up the teachings.
mn95:24.5: You weigh up the teachings because you make an attempt.
mn95:24.6: That’s why making an attempt is helpful for weighing up the teachings.”
mn95:25.1: “But what quality is helpful for making an attempt?
mn95:25.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for making an attempt.”
mn95:25.4: If enthusiasm doesn’t spring up, you won’t make an attempt.
mn95:25.5: You make an attempt because enthusiasm springs up.
mn95:25.6: That’s why enthusiasm is helpful for making an attempt.”
mn95:26.1: “But what quality is helpful for enthusiasm?
mn95:26.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for enthusiasm.”
mn95:26.4: If you don’t accept the teachings after deliberation, enthusiasm won’t spring up.
mn95:26.5: Enthusiasm springs up because you accept the teachings after deliberation.
mn95:26.6: That’s why acceptance of the teachings after deliberation is helpful for enthusiasm.”
mn95:27.1: “But what quality is helpful for accepting the teachings after deliberation?
mn95:27.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for accepting the teachings after deliberation.”
mn95:27.4: If you don’t examine the meaning of the teachings, you won’t accept them after deliberation.
mn95:27.5: You accept the teachings after deliberation because you examine their meaning.
mn95:27.6: That’s why examining the meaning of the teachings is helpful for accepting them after deliberation.”
mn95:28.1: “But what quality is helpful for examining the meaning of the teachings?
mn95:28.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for examining the meaning of the teachings.”
mn95:28.4: If you don’t remember the teachings, you won’t examine their meaning.
mn95:28.5: You examine their meaning because you remember the teachings.
mn95:28.6: That’s why remembering the teachings is helpful for examining their meaning.”
mn95:29.1: “But what quality is helpful for remembering the teachings?
mn95:29.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for remembering the teachings.”
mn95:29.4: If you don’t hear the teachings, you won’t remember them.
mn95:29.5: You remember the teachings because you hear them.
mn95:29.6: That’s why hearing the teachings is helpful for remembering the teachings.”
mn95:30.1: “But what quality is helpful for hearing the teachings?
mn95:30.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for hearing the teachings.”
mn95:30.4: If you don’t actively listen, you won’t hear the teachings.
mn95:30.5: You hear the teachings because you actively listen.
mn95:30.6: That’s why active listening is helpful for hearing the teachings.”
mn95:31.1: “But what quality is helpful for active listening?
mn95:31.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for active listening.”
mn95:31.4: If you don’t pay homage, you won’t actively listen.
mn95:31.5: You actively listen because you pay homage.
mn95:31.6: That’s why paying homage is helpful for active listening.”
mn95:32.1: “But what quality is helpful for paying homage?
mn95:32.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for paying homage.”
mn95:32.4: If you don’t approach a teacher, you won’t pay homage.
mn95:32.5: You pay homage because you approach a teacher.
mn95:32.6: That’s why approaching a teacher is helpful for paying homage.”
mn95:33.1: “But what quality is helpful for approaching a teacher?
mn95:33.2: I ask the worthy Gotama about the quality that is helpful for approaching a teacher.”
